workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation proof-out file emission IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can produce deterministic proof-out artifact payload facts, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room implementation that emits those facts as exactly two proof files.

splitDecision.reason: File emission from ready proof-out adapter facts is smaller than runtime validation execution and can be tested without starting LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare execution, live terminal proof, packaging, Marketplace, or launcher/profile mutation.
